messages:
Ethan (AE): FYI - Greenwood Medical procurement asked for SOC2 Type II, ISO 27001 cert, a pen-test letter on letterhead, and the current subprocessor list. They want items shared before their vendor review on Mon. Is that feasible?

Redwood Compliance Bot: Ticket created #REQ-2026-448. Please CC Legal for NDA/transfer approval.

Priya - Security Eng: We have SOC2 (period ending 2025-12) and ISO 27001 cert (cert# RW-ISO-2024). Pen-test was done by RedTeam Co in 2025-11. We can provide: (1) SOC2 redacted PDF, (2) ISO cert PDF, (3) pen-test attestation letter on RWD letterhead (exec summary only). Full pen-test findings require a DSA + legal OK.

Tara - Solutions Eng: They also asked for details about data residency and whether logs can be exported for an external audit. If they need export access for an auditor ride-along, that needs a scoped agreement + scheduling with Eng-Infra. Could be a multi-week lead time.

Ethan (AE): Procurement says "need everything for Monday morning review" — they attached their NDA in the email. I'll paste link: https://drive.redwood/sales/greenwood/greenwood-nda.pdf

Ken (Legal): I'll review the NDA. Quick checklist: SOC2/ISO/pen-test may be shared via secure evidence portal (evidence.redwood.com) after redaction and Legal sign-off. For auditor ride-alongs we require a signed Auditor Access Agreement + PO specifying scope/dates. Expect Legal response within 48 hours.

Priya - Security Eng: Note on redactions: customer names / sample client data / internal IPs are removed. Subprocessor list can be shared as a CSV but we need to confirm it contains no contract-sensitive pricing.

Tara - Solutions Eng: Pricing note for Greenwood: Dedicated/private setups for regulated PHI workloads have a minimum commitment of $18k/mo and lead time for provisioning. We can do a timeboxed POC (14d) on hosted if they accept tighter SLAs. That often determines procurement movement.

Ethan (AE): They also asked if we can provide a SOC2 bridge letter for 2026 since their review is in Q1. Do we have a template?

Priya - Security Eng: We do not issue auditor-signed bridge letters. We can create an internal attestation that controls are unchanged since last report and provide recent control-owner evidence snapshots. If they insist on a formal bridge, they must coordinate with the auditor firm.

Redwood Compliance Bot: Reminder: any external share must be uploaded to evidence.redwood.com and reference ticket #REQ-2026-448.

Ken (Legal): Agreed. Once I sign off on the NDA I'll approve the redacted SOC2 + ISO cert + pen-test attestation (letterhead). If Greenwood requests full findings or log-level exports, we'll need DSA + Auditor Access Agreement.

Tara - Solutions Eng: I'll prepare an "evidence checklist" and a short runbook for the POC options (hosted vs dedicated) and include lead times, pricing, and required legal docs. Can someone confirm Greenwood's SSO method (SAML/OIDC)?

Ethan (AE): Contact is vendors@greenwoodmedical.org. I'll ping them for SAML metadata and confirm timeline.

Priya - Security Eng: I'll draft the pen-test attestation (scope, vendor, date, statement of findings redaction) and share internally at https://internal.redwood/compliance/drafts. Ken - flag me when NDA is cleared and I'll finalize for signature.

Ethan (AE): Great. I'll tell procurement we aim to deliver redacted bundle to the evidence portal within 48-72 hours after Legal sign-off. Thanks all :white_check_mark:
